**Finding: missing (critical)** — no indemnity provision exists anywhere in the Site Development and Hosting Agreement.

- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infringe" returned nothing; the agreement runs from mutual warranties (Section 9, p0055–p0058) straight into General Provisions (Section 10, p0059).
- Result: HDI owes us no defense or indemnity for third-party IP claims arising from the hosted Site, nor for its own breach of law, breach of the Section 8 confidentiality/customer-data obligations, or gross negligence/willful misconduct — walk-away territory under INDEMN.
- Redline (validated ok:true): new Section 9A inserted after p0058 with (a) HDI's indemnity per the model language, carving out Content/Marks we supply; (b) a narrow Company indemnity limited to our Content/Marks and our breach of law; and (c) standard notice, control-of-defense (no adverse settlement without consent) and cooperation mechanics.
